categories.name: Print-Tech Paper
categories.summary: Software sold through the language of print: warm paper grounds, halftone texture, mono coordinate labels and editorial serifs. Feels considered, analog and trustworthy.
categories.typography: Editorial serif for headlines (Instrument Serif, GT Sectra, Tiempos) paired with a monospace for labels and metadata.
categories.color: Off-white or cream paper, ink black, one warm accent (vermillion, burnt orange) or a pale sage.
categories.layout: Generous margins, centered hero copy, small mono annotations parked at the edges like print slugs.
categories.motion: Minimal. Slow fades, ink-bleed reveals, numbers ticking like a counter.
categories.useWhen: AI or data products that want to feel calm, crafted and editorial instead of neon-tech.
categories.avoid: Glossy gradients, glassmorphism, heavy drop shadows.

categories.name: Dither Mono
categories.summary: One or two colors, everything rendered through ordered or error-diffusion dithering. Retro computing meets fine-art print.
categories.typography: Bitmap or grotesk mono (Departure Mono, Space Mono, IBM Plex Mono); oversized headlines in a tight grotesk.
categories.color: Strict 1-2 ink palette: black on bone, green on black, blue on white.
categories.layout: Hard grid, full-bleed dithered imagery, sharp rectangles, no rounded corners.
categories.motion: Dither resolution changing on hover, stepped (non-eased) transitions.
categories.useWhen: Developer tools, music, archives and brands that want texture without color.
categories.avoid: Smooth gradients and soft shadows, which break the 1-bit illusion.

categories.name: Vast Quiet Cinematic
categories.summary: Huge landscapes or skies, small type, lots of negative space. The page feels like a film still where the product is a quiet presence.
categories.typography: Light-weight serif or refined sans, small sizes, wide tracking on labels.
categories.color: Desaturated natural tones driven by the photograph; text in white or near-black.
categories.layout: Full-bleed media, single focal line of copy, content revealed further down.
categories.motion: Slow parallax, gentle zoom (Ken Burns), long crossfades.
categories.useWhen: Premium, wellness, travel, mission-driven brands and launches.
categories.avoid: Busy UI chrome above the fold; it kills the stillness.

categories.name: Data-as-Texture
categories.summary: Charts, coordinates, contour lines and raw numbers used as decoration. The data is the illustration.
categories.typography: Neo-grotesk headlines, mono for every number, tabular figures.
categories.color: Pale tinted ground (sage, ice, bone) with dark ink lines and one signal color.
categories.layout: Central generative object, floating data cards and callouts anchored with leader lines.
categories.motion: Lines drawing in, numbers counting, objects rotating slowly.
categories.useWhen: Fintech, analytics, infra and AI platforms that need to signal precision.
categories.avoid: Fake data that reads as lorem ipsum; keep the numbers plausible.

categories.name: Classical Remix
categories.summary: Museum material (statues, engravings, old masters) cut up and recombined with modern UI and type.
categories.typography: High-contrast didone or classical serif, set against a crisp modern sans.
categories.color: Stone, sepia, deep black, with a single modern accent (electric blue, acid green).
categories.layout: Asymmetric collage, layered cutouts, caption blocks like gallery placards.
categories.motion: Parallax layers in the collage, slow reveals.
categories.useWhen: Brands that want gravitas with a wink: culture, finance, education, creative tools.
categories.avoid: Using the art straight; the remix (crop, overlay, contrast) is the point.

categories.name: Glitched Antiquity
categories.summary: Old imagery broken by digital artifacts: pixel sorting, datamosh, RGB split. History running on corrupted hardware.
categories.typography: Classical serif cut with a glitch, or a stark mono on top of the noise.
categories.color: Sepia or grayscale base with saturated RGB fringes.
categories.layout: Big image fields, broken slices, overlapping horizontal bands.
categories.motion: Glitch flickers on hover, scrubbed scanlines.
categories.useWhen: Security, Web3, music and art projects with an edge.
categories.avoid: Overdoing it; one glitched zone reads intentional, everything glitched reads broken.

categories.name: Illustrated Storybook
categories.summary: Painterly or hand-drawn worlds that turn a product page into a scene. Warm, narrative, approachable.
categories.typography: Friendly serif or rounded sans; occasional hand-lettered word.
categories.color: Muted naturals (sage, ochre, dusty blue) with one warm accent.
categories.layout: Centered illustration as hero, copy sitting in the sky or a clearing.
categories.motion: Gentle idle loops (clouds, water), scroll-told chapters.
categories.useWhen: Consumer apps, education, wellness, anything that should feel human.
categories.avoid: Mixing illustration styles across a page.

categories.name: Swiss Grid
categories.summary: International Typographic Style: strict grids, flush-left grotesk, big numbers, primary color blocks.
categories.typography: One grotesk family (Helvetica Now, Neue Haas, Inter Display) in 2-3 weights.
categories.color: White, black and one primary (red is classic).
categories.layout: Visible 12-column logic, type as the main image, alignment over decoration.
categories.motion: Snappy slides along the grid, nothing bouncy.
categories.avoid: Centered everything; Swiss work lives on the left edge.

entries.title: Quiet Workspace (sample)
entries.description: A calm AI writing tool framed as a printed page: halftone tree on a paper ground, coordinates in the corners.
entries.prompt: [SUBJECT: a lone tree on a grassy hill] printed as a coarse CMYK halftone on warm uncoated paper, visible dot rosettes, slight riso misregistration, generous empty sky for typography, muted greens and burnt orange, no gradients

entries.title: Ledger AI (sample)
entries.description: Finance platform hero with a topographic coin object, mono receipt callouts and a pale sage ground.
entries.prompt: [SUBJECT: a coin] rendered only from stacked topographic contour lines, plotter-pen black ink on pale sage, isometric three-quarter view, no fills, crisp vector feel, centered with empty space around

entries.title: Halftone Sails Collage (sample)
entries.description: Archival sailing photos broken into halftone dot fields and cream blocks, with a technical circle overlay.
entries.prompt: [SUBJECT: a tall ship under sail] archival photograph converted to large halftone dots, cut into rectangular collage panels on cream, thin technical circle and crosshair overlay, sepia and charcoal only

entries.title: Signal Terminal (sample)
entries.description: Developer platform hero: a dithered satellite dish on black, phosphor green type, hard-edged UI.
entries.prompt: [SUBJECT: a satellite dish at night] rendered as 1-bit Atkinson dither, phosphor green on pure black, no grays, visible pixel grain, wide crop with empty left half for text

entries.title: Bone Archive (sample)
entries.description: Archive index where every object photo is ordered-dithered in black on bone; grid of tiles with mono captions.
entries.prompt: [SUBJECT: a ceramic vase] photographed straight-on, converted to 4x4 Bayer ordered dither, black ink on bone paper, centered object, flat even light

entries.title: Stillness (sample)
entries.description: Meditation landscape built from blocks: digital material, calm subject, serif headline with a green emphasis word.
entries.prompt: [SUBJECT: a mountain valley with a river and pine trees] built entirely from small 3D voxels, diorama style, strict muted palette of slate blue, white snow, coral accent patches and sage foliage, soft studio light, isolated on a clean white ground with empty space above

entries.title: Gouache Garden (sample)
entries.description: Feature row where each benefit is a small gouache vignette in a rounded frame.
entries.prompt: [SUBJECT: a fox reading under a lamp] gouache illustration with visible brush texture and paper grain, ochre, sage and deep slate palette, picture-book composition, soft warm light

entries.title: Horizon (sample)
entries.description: Full-bleed desert dawn with one small line of centered type; the product appears only after the first scroll.
entries.prompt: [SUBJECT: a desert plateau at dawn] ultra-wide cinematic establishing shot, thick atmospheric haze, a tiny lone figure on the horizon, desaturated warm tones, 35mm film grain, vast empty sky

entries.title: Ice Field (sample)
entries.description: Glacier aerials as section dividers, thin white serif, letterboxed video bands.
entries.prompt: [SUBJECT: an aerial view of a glacier] letterboxed 2.39:1 cinematic frame, pale blue and white, soft overcast light, minimal detail, large calm negative space

entries.title: Marble Capital (sample)
entries.description: A cropped marble bust collaged with UI cards and an electric blue accent; captions styled as museum placards.
entries.prompt: [SUBJECT: a classical marble bust] dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, cut out cleanly and collaged with flat electric-blue rectangles, stone and black palette, editorial magazine composition

entries.title: Engraved Index (sample)
entries.description: Footer built around a large 18th-century engraving with roman-numeral nav columns.
entries.prompt: [SUBJECT: a celestial map] in fine copperplate engraving linework, sepia ink on aged paper, intricate crosshatching, centered with wide margins

entries.title: Corrupt Relic (sample)
entries.description: Old portrait photograph with horizontal pixel-sorted bands and RGB fringes behind a stark mono headline.
entries.prompt: [SUBJECT: a 19th-century portrait photograph] partially corrupted with horizontal pixel-sorting bands and red/cyan channel split, sepia base, one clean undamaged area on the face

entries.title: Red Index (sample)
entries.description: Agency index page: oversized numerals, flush-left list, one red block marking the active item.
entries.prompt: [SUBJECT: abstract poster] International Typographic Style composition, strict modular grid, solid red rectangle, black geometric forms on white, no texture
